# `silk/system/host_path`

Resolves host filesystem paths through symbolic links without changing the working directory.

Import as `HostPath` with `import silk.system.host_path as HostPath`.

## `canonicalBytes`

```silk
pub effect fn canonicalBytes(path: &[u8]) -> Option<Bytes> ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

The canonical path of `path` with every symbolic link resolved, or `None` when the host cannot
resolve it.
